primary.raw_type: track-guided toy kart motion around a curved and raised looped track

action.raw_action: no visible external intervention; the toy kart enters the frame already moving

temporal.raw_temporal_description: The toy kart moves continuously through the visible track path, including more than one visible pass across the raised loop section.

transition.raw_transition: The toy kart repeatedly changes travel direction and orientation as it follows the foreground curve, raised loop, inner track section, and then exits the visible area.

mechanisms.raw_mechanism: Contact and support from the blue track constrain and redirect the toy kart's rigid motion along the curved and raised loop path; the source of the kart's propulsion is not visible.
